slides.text: Tragic, powerful, but one of the most well written characters I've read in a long time.
I've not felt like I know a character as well as Lady Morgan in just one book.
Sophie Keetch gives her a full life, an interesting personality, all in a world built around her.
It shows Morgan Le Fay character in a way most retellings of familiar myths haven't bothered to.
She is a character that, in most tellings of this legend, is written as a villain, if she's included at all.
The adaptation of this story is just as tragic as it is powerful, but I've not felt so optimistic for a character's arc for a long time.
